sources.title: Groundwater level telemetry, Jaipur district: Rajasthan Ground Water Department and CGWB six-hourly resources on the National Water Data Portal
sources.publisher: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC), Ministry of Jal Shakti

provenance.note: Monthly means of six-hourly telemetry per station, after the shared quality rules; stations placed by coordinates in the IN-GRES unit polygons, not by their district tag.

aquifer: Not published per station; shallow and deep piezometers sit side by side
cadence_note: Telemetric recorders reading every six hours; shown as monthly means. Months with no reading that passed the quality rules are absent, not zero.

wells.name: Jaisingpur Khor_1
wells.quality_note: Readings rose from about 56 m below ground in mid-2024 to about 18 m by August 2024 and have stayed under 15 m since. The portal gives no reason for a rise this large, so treat the latest depth with care.

wells.name: Luniawas
wells.quality_note: Readings sit about 2 m below ground until October 2025 and about 44 m from February 2026. The portal does not explain the step, so compare readings only within each stretch.

wells.name: RJGW_8990
wells.quality_note: Readings step from about 59 m below ground (2025) to about 92-96 m (2026) across a gap of six months. The portal does not explain the step, so compare readings only within each stretch.

wells.name: RJGW_9061
wells.quality_note: Readings step from about 77-103 m below ground (early 2025) to about 33 m (from July 2026) across a gap of more than a year. The portal does not explain the step, so compare readings only within each stretch.

wells.name: TIGARIA_1
wells.quality_note: Readings step from about 55-65 m below ground in 2025 to 12-19 m in early 2026 and about 36-41 m from April 2026. The portal does not explain the steps, so compare readings only within each stretch.

wells.name: Trilokinathpura
wells.quality_note: The level reads about 42 m below ground until January 2025, between 1 m and 11 m from February 2025 to March 2026, and about 40 m again from May 2026. The portal does not explain the steps, so compare readings only within each stretch.
